homogeneous_reduction.eta_L: Ward-dependent reaction paired with the removed E row

separate_equations.gauge: E=0 may be chosen only after the momentum equation

variation.B1: one common C_partial integral sqrt|h| R4; at fixed h its variation and Hessian with respect to bulk fields vanish
variation.GHY: kappa_1 integral_B1 sqrt|h| K on each cap; cancels normal derivatives of delta gamma cap by cap
variation.P1: (1/2) integral sqrt|g|(kappa_1 R5-kappa_0), two reflected caps
variation.Ward_identity: D^mu(Pi_mu_nu-Lambda_mu_nu)=0 after the bulk momentum constraint; scalar momentum and traceless-longitudinal rows are the two dependent scalar projections
arbitrary_variations: bulk delta gamma_mu_nu including its B1 trace
bulk delta sigma with odd Dirichlet B1 data
variation.intrinsic_B1_reason: S_B1 is a functional of independent fixed h, not of the bulk induced metric before the matcher equation is solved
variation.matcher: integral_B1 sqrt|h| Lambda^(mu nu)(h_mu nu-iota^*gamma_mu nu)

matcher_equations.delta_h: not imposed in Gamma[h,q] because h is fixed

variation.total_action: S_P1,+ + S_P1,- + S_GHY,+ + S_GHY,- + S_scalar + S_B1 + S_match
variation.two_cap_orientation: outward normals reverse under cap exchange while the common-normal canonical-momentum jump adds the two reflected responses
